methods.test_02_authenticate_login_to_retrieve_t: Authenticate Login to retrieve temporary access_token -> Use the "email": "admin@example.com" and "password": "admin123", but do not include mode and otp. Also Retrieve the access_token from the response; Create a new folder -> Use the above retrieved access_token as bearer token, Use a random alphabetical string to provide as an input to the folder name, but don't include parent option in the payload, Retrieve the ID from the response; Get the list of folder names -> Use the above retrieved access_token as bearer token -> Validate that the response has a record with the above generated and retrieved ID along with the above used folder name; Delete a folder using folder id -> Use the above retrieved access_token as bearer token -> Use  the same above retrieved ID  to delete in this request; Get the list of folder names -> Use the above retrieved access_token as bearer token -> Validate that the response NOT included with the record having above created folder name and retrived ID, if it is existing by chance then throw with an appropriate error

methods.test_01_authenticate_login_to_retrieve_t:
Authenticate Login to retrieve temporary access_token -> Use the "email": "admin@example.com" and "password": "admin123", but do not include mode and otp. Also Retrieve the access_token from the response;
Create a new folder -> Use the above retrieved access_token as bearer token, Set a blank value input to the folder name, and also don't include parent option in the payload -> Validate that the response returns an error with status code 400;
methods.test_02_authenticate_login_to_retrieve_t:
Authenticate Login to retrieve temporary access_token -> Use the "email": "admin@example.com" and "password": "admin123", but do not include mode and otp. Also Retrieve the access_token from the response;
Retrieve a single folder by unique identifier -> Use the above retrieved access_token as bearer token, Use a random alphabetical string as a id -> Validate that the response returns an error with status code 404;
methods.test_03_authenticate_login_to_retrieve_t:
Authenticate Login to retrieve temporary access_token -> Use the "email": "admin@example.com" and "password": "admin123", but do not include mode and otp. Also Retrieve the access_token from the response;
